passages.text: 圖外層所列為正針乃二十四山之正位內層所列為中針
passages.disposition: Outer/inner role explicitly named; preserve each ring coordinate.

passages.text: 其子位在正針壬子二位之間比正針先半位
passages.disposition: Middle Zi precedes regular Zi by half a position; degrees are separately derived.

passages.text: 其雙取者為雙山其取三合者為雙山五行
passages.disposition: Pair then combine triads; not a universal regular five-element lookup.

passages.text: 地理家格龍用之蓋龍為來脈故用先至者承之乃無失也
passages.disposition: Source application/reasoning recorded as source claim, not observed outcome.

passages.text: 圖外層所列為正針內層所列為縫針
passages.disposition: Seam is inner, regular is outer.

passages.text: 其子位在正針子癸二位之間比正針後半位
passages.disposition: Seam Zi follows regular Zi by half a position.

passages.text: 其雙取三合者為三合五行與雙山同特比中針正差一位耳
passages.disposition: Same named pair/element system but middle/seam positions differ by one regular position.

passages.text: 地理家用以消砂納水蓋砂水為去路故用後至者收之乃無遺也
passages.disposition: Separate source use for sand/water; no room, true/magnetic north, or practical outcome inferred.

passages.text: 按雙山五行即三合五行也地支十二取生旺墓三者為三合局而四卦八干各在支前一位今以支前一位之卦干與支雙並而同取地支三合之五行故曰雙山五行
passages.disposition: Twelve branch life/prosperity/tomb positions pair with preceding four trigrams/eight stems.

passages.text: 坤申壬子乙辰合水局六山皆屬水乾亥甲卯丁
passages.disposition: Water group complete; wood group continues across leaf.

passages.text: 未合木局六山皆屬木艮寅丙午辛戌合火局六山皆屬火巽巳庚酉癸丑合金局六山皆屬金
地理書曰正五行乃五行之質雙山五行乃五行之氣故推龍氣之生旺用雙山而不用正五行也
passages.disposition: Quoted traditional distinction 質/氣 retained; not an empirical mechanism.

passages.text: 又地理家有三針一曰正針乃二十四山之正位定向用之一曰中針其子位在正針壬子二位之中格龍用之一曰縫針其子位在正針子癸二位之縫消砂納水用之
passages.disposition: All three uses and Zi anchors explicitly enumerated.

passages.text: 故中針與縫針差一位雙山五行在中針則曰雙山五行在縫針則曰三合五行其實皆
passages.disposition: Names depend on ring; common paired method does not equate physical positions.
Final four characters read; rest of page is ruled blank.

punctuation: Editorial segmentation; continuous image text preserved without invented punctuation.
